item.title: A Learning Journey
item.description: This blog is a record of my learning journey as I develop new skills in docs-as-code documentation site building.
item.content:encoded:
This blog is a record of my learning journey as I develop new skills in docs-as-code documentation site building.

I have deep skills in documentation - research, interview, experiement, draft, revise polish, and publish in various formats - but now I am learning the ins and outs of automated docs-as-code workflows.
